articles.title: Venue ready for the Victorian Junior Rapid and Blitz Championship
articles.excerpt: A first look at the prepared venue ahead of the Victorian Junior Rapid and Blitz Championship in Bacchus Marsh.
articles.imageAlt: Chess tables prepared in the hall for the Victorian Junior Rapid and Blitz Championship.
paragraphs: HBCC shared photographs of the prepared playing hall ahead of the 2026 Victorian Junior Rapid and Blitz Championship.
The rows of boards, clocks and tables were ready for the junior players. The championship was scheduled for 3–4 October in Bacchus Marsh.

articles.title: Record turnout for women's chess in Altona
articles.excerpt: Star Weekly reports on 42 players at the Victorian Women's Championship and the growing participation of women and girls.
articles.imageAlt: A championship participant holds her trophy beside a club representative at the HBCC awards presentation.
paragraphs: HBCC shared Star Weekly's coverage of the 2026 Victorian Women's Championship, held in Altona on 12 and 19 September.
The newspaper reported a field of 42 players, up 40 per cent from 2025. Deethya Sai Katakam and Narelle Szuveges shared first place.
The report also highlighted the participation of junior girls and the live broadcast of games. Read the original story for the full report.

articles.title: Victorian Women's Championship awards and photo gallery
articles.excerpt: HBCC and Geelong Chess Club celebrate the championship participants and share the awards photographs.
articles.imageAlt: A championship participant holds a trophy between two representatives at the HBCC awards presentation.
paragraphs: Hobsons Bay Chess Club has shared its photo gallery from the 2026 Victorian Women's Championship and awards presentation.
HBCC and Geelong Chess Club co-organised the event under Chess Victoria. The club thanked Melissa Horne MP for presenting awards to the participants.
The original Facebook album includes the championship photographs and moments from the presentation.
